---mode: agentdescription: Batch 10. Connect Splitwise, link people and groups, and pull expenses and payments into review. Read only. About 50K tokens.---
Build batch 10 only. Nothing is posted to Splitwise.
Read: `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/domain/value.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/views/PeopleView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SettleView.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `src/adapters/splitwise.ts`.
## API
All in this prompt. Do not fetch the docs.
- Base: `https://secure.splitwise.com/api/v3.0`. Header: `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.- A response whose `errors` field is non-empty is a failure, even with HTTP 200.- A network or CORS failure is shown and stops the action. No proxy, no server.- `GET /get_current_user` returns `{ user: { id, first_name, last_name } }`.- `GET /get_friends` returns `{ friends: [{ id, first_name, last_name }] }`.- `GET /get_groups` returns `{ groups: [{ id, name, members: [{ id, first_name, last_name }] }] }`. Ignore group id 0.- `GET /get_expenses?friend_id=` or `group_id=`, plus `dated_after` or `updated_after`, `limit=100`, and `offset`. Page until fewer than 100 come back.  - Each expense: `id`, `group_id`, `description`, `date`, `cost`, `currency_code`, `payment`, `updated_at`, `deleted_at`, `users: [{ user_id, paid_share, owed_share }]`.  - Amounts are strings. Convert them with `value.ts`. Reject any currency except AUD.  - Use the first 10 characters of `date`.
## Build
1. `splitwise.ts` holds the key in a module variable, never in React state, the JSON, the console, or an error message. It exports `setKey`, `hasKey`, `getCurrentUser`, `getFriends`, `getGroups`, and `getExpenses`. `PeopleView` sets the key from a password field.2. `file-ledger.ts`, all optional.   - A person or group entity gets `splitwise: { kind: "user" | "group", id }`.   - `splitwiseSync`: `id`, `entityId`, `lastPulledAt`, `updatedAt`.   - `splitwiseInbox`: `id`, `splitwiseExpenseId`, `entityId`, `date`, `description`, `costCents`, `yourPaidCents`, `yourOwedCents`, `isPayment`, `status` (`new | changed | deleted | done | dismissed`), `updatedAt`.   - `splitwisePosts`: `id`, `entryId`, `entityId`, `state` (`posting | posted | unknown`), `splitwiseExpenseId`, `updatedAt`.   - An entry gets optional `splitwiseExpenseId` (null).3. `PeopleView`: "Connect Splitwise" asks for the key and shows your name. Link a person to a friend, or a group to a group.4. Pull, per linked entity.   - The first pull asks for a "since" date and uses `dated_after`. Later pulls use `updated_after` from `lastPulledAt`.   - A friend pull skips expenses with a group id other than null or 0. Group expenses belong to the group's pull.   - An id already in the inbox, an entry, or a post: if `updated_at` moved, the status becomes `changed`. If `deleted_at` is set, it becomes `deleted`. Otherwise nothing happens.   - Expenses where your paid and owed shares are both zero are skipped.5. `ReviewView`, a "From Splitwise" section for inbox items that are not payments, with status `new`, `changed`, or `deleted`.   - Expense paid by the other side, where your paid share is 0: Confirm creates a spend. The payer is the entity, the amount is the cost, the self portion is your owed share, and the rest goes to the entity. `countsTowardDebt` is true and `splitwiseExpenseId` is set.   - Before creating it, look for an entry with the same payer and amount dated within 3 days. If one exists, offer Link, which only sets `splitwiseExpenseId`, or Create.   - Expense you paid in full: link it to a matching local entry with the same rule, and record a `posted` post. With no match, Create uses payer self, a self portion of your owed share, and the rest to the entity.   - Partly paid by you: say "Enter by hand" and offer Dismiss.   - `changed` and `deleted` show what changed. The user edits the entry by hand, then marks the item done.   - Confirm, Link, and Create mark the item done.6. `SettleView`: payment items for the entity appear under "Recorded in Splitwise". Record creates a settlement with `splitwisePaymentId` and marks the item done. The direction is `theyPaidYou` when your paid share is 0.
## Tests
One test in `tests/ledger.test.ts`, no network: a sample expense with a cost of "60.00", the friend paying "60.00", and you owing "25.00" creates a spend where you owe that entity $25. Mapping the same id again creates nothing.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. With your key, link one friend and pull. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 11.
